about.description: Shrimp Basket is a Gulf Coast seafood restaurant serving fresh, hand-breaded shrimp, coastal classics, and Southern hospitality since 1993. With locations across the Southeast, Shrimp Basket offers dine-in, takeout, online ordering, and catering for seafood lovers seeking laid-back coastal flavor.
about.elevator_pitch: A Gulf Coast seafood restaurant serving hand-breaded shrimp and coastal classics with Southern hospitality since 1993.
about.vibe: Casual, family-focused, laid-back coastal atmosphere with a beach escape feel.
about.insider_tip: Located in Gulf Shores, Alabama where it all began; now with 18 locations across Alabama, Florida, and Mississippi.
